title: Reasonable Doubt Season 4: New Cast, Premiere Date, and More
text:
Reasonable Doubt is back with a new season, featuring Morris Chestnut, Dr. Durrell 'Tank' Babbs Sr., and La La Anthony. Get ready for the premiere on Hulu and catch up on other exciting entertainment news.
Reasonable Doubt is gearing up for its fourth season, and fans are eager to see what's in store. While star Emayatzy Corinealdi will be returning as Jacqueline 'Jax' Stewart, she is noticeably absent from the recently released photos.
Instead, Morris Chestnut takes center stage, appearing in multiple images alongside newcomer Dr. Durrell 'Tank' Babbs Sr., who will be making his debut in the upcoming season. La La Anthony is also set to join the cast in season 4. Reasonable Doubt follows Jax, a skilled defense lawyer navigating a complex personal life while excelling in the courtroom. Corey, played by Morris Chestnut, is a talented attorney recruited by Jax to assist with a case.
Chestnut first appeared in season 2 and reprised his role in season 3. This season, Tank, portrayed by Dr. Durrell 'Tank' Babbs Sr., will be introduced as a wealthy and powerful recording artist with a history with Jax. Despite his charm and calculating nature, Tank's presence brings significant challenges to Jax's firm. Reasonable Doubt Season 4 is set to premiere on Hulu on October 6, 2026.
The first three episodes will be available on that day, with new episodes airing weekly on Tuesdays. In other entertainment news, Netflix has shared new posters for its upcoming true-crime thriller film, Unabomber, featuring Russell Crowe. A separate thriller film starring Samara Weaving and Nicholas Braun involves a deadly encounter with killer wasps. The new Resident Evil movie has received an R rating from the MPAA for strong bloody violence, gore, and language.
Meanwhile, Alan Ritchson's action thriller, Motor City, is now available for audiences to enjoy at home. Dolly Parton's cause of death has been revealed by her representatives, putting an end to speculation. In Reacher Season 4, Episode 5, the mystery surrounding Anna Merrick's USB flash drive finally receives a partial answer. Joseph Gordon-Levitt is set to star in a Shōgun-like TV show from Hulu, with Shōgun co-executive producer Shannon Goss attached to the project.
Ted Lasso's return to London in season 4 has a surprising reason, revealed in the premiere. Lastly, Ryan Murphy's Monster Season 4 has unveiled its first photos and official poster, showcasing the upcoming season's intense moments
